title: FSFE intervenes against Apple before EUCJ for the second time
summary: FSFE (Free Software Foundation Europe) has filed its second intervention against Apple before the European Court of Justice, continuing advocacy efforts for software freedom and digital sovereignty in Europe.
problem_solved: Addresses regulatory and legal challenges regarding Apple's practices in the European market that may affect free software principles and user rights.
why_valuable: This legal intervention demonstrates ongoing efforts by open source advocates to ensure technology companies comply with principles of software freedom and user autonomy within EU legal frameworks.
